If you’ve shopped for an Apple laptop recently, then you’ve probably come across MacBook Neo, MacBook Air, and MacBook Pro. Two of those models come in a variety of colors. The Neo comes in dark blue, green, pink, and silver. While the Air comes in light blue, light gold, dark gray, and silver. But for some reason MacBook Pro doesn’t come in any colors at all. Only dark gray and silver. Which is kind’ve odd, considering it’s the most expensive model.
title: Why Doesn't The MacBook Pro Come In Colors?
